qualifier: stress granule dynamics under arsenite/PKR stress
name: ARE-mediated mRNA decay and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members combine ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability (AUF1, TTP, BRF1, KSRP, HuR) with stress granule assembly, disassembly and arsenite/PKR stress signalling, which the ARE-only confusables lack.

name: Transferrin-DMT1 iron uptake and cadmium transport
rationale: Members cover transferrin endocytosis, SLC11A2/DMT1 iron import and iron homeostasis together with cadmium transport and detoxification, distinguishing them from zinc/copper/heme-focused confusables.

name: Non-canonical NF-kB via CD40, Dectin-1 and IKK defects
rationale: Members center on NIK-dependent NF-kB activation from TNFSF receptors, CD40 and Dectin-1 plus IKBKB/IKBKG/IkBA deficiency diseases, unlike TNFR1/TLR canonical or T cell activation confusables.

qualifier: factor VIII, IX and V variant defects
name: Coagulation cascade with factor VIII, IX and V defects
rationale: Members are the intrinsic/common coagulation cascade and many defective F8, F9 and FV variant events, which fibrinolysis- and VWF-focused confusables lack.

name: ACTH-driven cortisol secretion and glucocorticoid response
rationale: Members cover corticotropin and cortisol/glucocorticoid secretion and cellular responses to cortisol or dexamethasone, distinct from aldosterone synthesis, corticosterone stress behaviour or GH/leptin confusables.

name: Enhancement of cardiac contractility, rate and relaxation
rationale: All members upregulate heart contraction force, heart rate or cardiac relaxation, while confusables concern adrenergic secretion or calcium-release control and negative regulation.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and integrin-laminin basement membrane
name: Desmosome, hemidesmosome and integrin-laminin basement membrane adhesion
rationale: Members span desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament anchoring, integrin/laminin interactions and anchoring fibrils, unlike apical-junction or cornification confusables.

qualifier: chondroitin/dermatan and heparan sulfate (MPS I, II, VI, VII, IX)
name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation in mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are CS/DS and HS proteoglycan catabolism and the MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX defects in it, while confusables add keratan sulfate and Sanfilippo/Morquio types.

qualifier: Aurora A and NEK kinases at centrosome separation
name: Aurora A and NEK kinase control of centrosome separation
rationale: Members concern Aurora A regulation (PHLDA1, FBXL7), NEK9/6/7 activation and centrosome separation at mitotic entry, unlike spindle, APC/C or chromosome condensation confusables.

name: Dendrite arborization and filopodium assembly control
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, spine morphogenesis, filopodia and RHOF-driven actin, whereas confusables emphasize postsynaptic density and synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and paracellular magnesium
name: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members combine cation-chloride cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman diseases with tight-junction paracellular and magnesium transport; each confusable lacks one of these two arms.

name: PIEZO1 mechanosensing and calcium-activated membrane scrambling
rationale: Members cover PIEZO1 shear/load sensing, hydrostatic pressure, blebbing, membrane repair and volume, plus ANO6 calcium-activated scrambling that the nearest confusable lacks.

qualifier: TCR, CD27 costimulation and NIK-dependent NF-kB
name: T cell activation via TCR, CD27 and NIK-NF-kB
rationale: Members join TCR signaling, CD27, IL-2 production and T cell activation with non-canonical NIK/NF-kB activation, which separately distinguishes them from each confusable.

name: Transcriptional control of cadherin switching in EMT
rationale: Members regulate CDH1 and CDH11 transcription, cadherin adhesion and TGF-beta-driven EMT, unlike confusables about cadherin protein trafficking or junction assembly.

name: Left-right axis specification and visceral organ asymmetry
rationale: All members concern establishing left/right asymmetry, including liver, pancreas and gut laterality, distinct from germ-layer or motile cilium assembly confusables.

name: Skeletal myoblast commitment, fusion and fiber differentiation
rationale: Members are pro-myogenic skeletal muscle steps from myoblast fate to fiber differentiation, while confusables add cardiac growth, negative regulation, satellite cells or contraction.

qualifier: aryl hydrocarbon receptor and ascorbate metabolism
name: Aryl hydrocarbon xenobiotic response and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members combine AhR/dioxin, pesticide, bisphenol and genistein responses with vitamin C and E metabolism; confusables lack either the xenobiotic or the ascorbate arm.

qualifier: increased production, reduced clearance, glial and synaptic effects
name: Amyloid-beta accumulation effects on glia and synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members promote amyloid-beta formation and ectodomain shedding, impair its clearance and regulate glial activation and LTP, unlike microglial phagocytosis or clearance-promoting confusables.

core: DNA damage checkpoint and genome stability
name: DNA damage checkpoint and p53-driven genome stability
rationale: Members cover intra-S checkpoint signaling, recombination intermediate resolution, DNA stability and p53 control of repair genes, unlike replication or telomere confusables.

name: Cytosolic calcium clearance via SERCA and sodium-calcium exchange
rationale: Members lower cytosolic Ca2+ by ER/SR pumping and Na+/Ca2+ exchange, whereas confusables address release of sequestered calcium and muscle contraction.

name: mRNA 3'-end processing and decapping-mediated decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and transcription termination plus decapping and 5'-3' decay, which the export/splicing confusables lack.

name: Neutrophil antimicrobial granules and phagosomal peptide/metal transport
rationale: Members combine neutrophil granule and phagocytolytic programmes with oligopeptide/histidine, iron and ion transport at the host-pathogen interface, unlike acidification, histamine or iron-homeostasis confusables.

qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine receptor signaling
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT class I cytokine receptor pathways for GH, prolactin, leptin, IL-11, CNTF and TPO, the IL-6-family arm absent from erythropoietin or thyroid confusables.

name: Th2 cell differentiation and IL-5 production promotion
rationale: Members positively regulate Th2 differentiation, Th2 cytokine and IL-5 production and mast cell activation, unlike eosinophil, IL-4/IL-13 signaling or negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: imino acid/glycine transporters and Hartnup, iminoglycinuria
name: Neutral and imino acid transport in Hartnup and iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members are proline, glycine and tryptophan plasma-membrane transport by SLC6A19/SLC6A20/SLC36A2 and their diseases, unlike cystine, hexose or peptide transport confusables.
